The '''Basic Log''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that can be placed anywhere, indoors or out.  It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|250}} any day the shop is open.  It is not sold anywhere else.

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Can now be stacked in a player's [[inventory]] and in [[Chest|chests]].}}
